scope: full raw chirality tensor maps for AA/BB sectors
method: compute all four B_{rc,sc} independently; verify cross-parity vanishing and odd-odd match with Step 97

interpretation.B_same_chirality: B_{++} = B_{--} = B_ee + B_oo (verified by chirality_equalities_check)
interpretation.B_cross_chirality: B_{+-} = B_{-+} = B_ee - B_oo (verified by chirality_equalities_check)
interpretation.P_channel: isotropic response, coefficient of w in zeta = Pw + Qw_bar
interpretation.Q_channel: anisotropic response, coefficient of w_bar; nonzero Q requires sigma-matching
interpretation.physical_determinant: |P|^2 - |Q|^2 = 0 for degenerate (solvable) map; nonzero determinant means invertible (obstructed)
interpretation.solvability_correction: A02's |Q|>|P| -> solvable is WRONG. |P|^2 - |Q|^2 < 0 still gives an invertible map with eigenvalues of opposite sign; kernel requires |P|=|Q| exactly.
